title: Append K Integers With Minimal Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, append k distinct positive integers not present in nums to nums to achieve the smallest possible total sum.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, append k distinct positive integers not present in nums to nums to achieve the smallest possible total sum. Return the sum of these k integers.
constraints: Choose k distinct positive integers absent from nums.
Duplicate values in nums forbid that value only once and do not change k.
Return the smallest possible sum of chosen values.
reference_solution:
def minimum_missing_positive_sum(nums,k):
    answer=0;current=1
    for value in sorted(set(nums)):
        if value<current:continue
        take=min(k,value-current)
        answer+=(current+current+take-1)*take//2;k-=take;current=value+1
        if k==0:return answer
    return answer+(current+current+k-1)*k//2

hints: Always choose the smallest currently available positive integers.
Sort unique forbidden values and consume each missing arithmetic interval in order.
For every gap take up to k values and add its arithmetic-series sum; after all gaps take the next k consecutive values.
Any solution using a larger available value while a smaller one remains can exchange them to reduce the sum, proving the greedy order.
